title: Easy to Use
text: Easy to Use. My daughter lives in a duplex. The refrigerator does not have an ice maker. She has a counter top one, but it's been on the fritz lately. I ordered this for her so she can continue to make ice. The size is good. She was worried that it would take up a lot of space in the freezer. It's compact and doesn't have a big foot print. I like that it has a storage bin along with the trays rather than having to purchase separate pieces. It's also much quieter than the counter top unit.

product_metadata.title: Teblei Ice Cube Tray with Lid and Bin, Easy Release & 50 Nugget Ice Cube Trays for Freezer, 2 Pack Stackable Silicone Ice Cube Molds with Tong, for Whiskey, Cocktail (Orange)
features: 🍹【Easy Release Design】Ice cube making has never been so enjoyable! Designed with an innovative structure, all ice cubes can be released with just one press and get 25x2 ice cubes. Easily! Quickly! Smoothly!

🍹【Practical Ice Bin】ice tray kit comes with a large-capacity ice storage bin (0.5 gallon), which can be used in conjunction with the ice tray, to catch the ice cubes without falling scattered. Also, the spare ice cubes can be stored in the ice bin for next time use.

🍹【Safe & Durable】This ice cube tray with lid and bin is made of durable food-grade silicone and premium PP materials, BPA free and odor free. What's more, the covered lid prevents your ice cubes from absorbing odors from the refrigerator.

🍹【Perfect Cube Size】Ice cubes shaped in ideal size 0.9''L x 0.9''W x 0.8''H, suitable for various beverages like juice, coffee, beer, soda, etc. Or Let your creativity flow, create your own colorful DIY ice cubes by adding tasty fruit or other food you like.
🍹【Complimentary Accessories】We consider your needs, and thoughtfully offer additional scoop for your convenience. Spend the same and get more!
👉【Kindly Note-1】Please do not put all the components into the dishwasher for cleaning. The high temperature may cause deformed and damaged.
